## Steve Platt

### Tenure

c.[1999](/wiki/1999) - c.[2001](/wiki/2001)

### Signature

[![StevenPlattSig](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/1/17/StevenPlattSig.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/150?cb=20251022194809)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/1/17/StevenPlattSig.png/revision/latest?cb=20251022194809)

**Steven Michael Platt** is a designer and modelmaker who worked at [Mattel](/wiki/Mattel) from roughly [1999](/wiki/1999) until sometime around [2001](/wiki/2001) after landing his position due to a conversation with his neighbor. Platt collaborated with [Dave Martis](/wiki/Dave_Martis) to design the casting [Steel Flame](/wiki/Steel_Flame) depicting his custom 1999 GMC Sonoma build and was one of the youngest in the design center.

In his personal life he was born in San Diego, California and moved to the South Bay area at a young age skateboarding, BMX biking, and bodyboarding. Platt has familial roots in remote control model racing under an owned team and has held positions at other companies including Audio Options and Jada Toys. He currently owns a metal fabrication shop titled SMP Designs out of the Las Vegas, Nevada area and is known under the handles smp61 and smpdesignslv on Instagram.
